team.title: Submit your result
team.subtitle: Send your own row for this map. An organizer checks it before it counts.
team.claimNotice: This is a claim, not a result. Nothing changes on the standings until an organizer approves it.
team.didNotPlay: We did not play this map
team.sent: Sent. The organizer will review it.
team.failed: Could not send that. Try again.
team.none: You have not sent anything for this map yet.
team.closed: This event is not taking result submissions from teams.

queue.title: Results teams sent in
queue.subtitle: Each team files its own row. Nothing is counted until you approve it.
queue.empty: No team has sent a result for this map.
queue.conflictHelp: Two teams cannot both be right. Correct one before approving it.
queue.sanctionHint: Bonus and penalty are yours to set. A team cannot ask for either.
queue.rejectPrompt: Tell the team what is wrong. They will read this, and it saves you a second round trip.
queue.rejectPlaceholder: For example: your placement does not match the lobby screenshot.
queue.rejected: Rejected. The team can see your note.
queue.actionFailed: That did not go through. Try again.
queue.changedFromSubmitted: You changed this from what they sent

settings.label: Let teams submit their own map results
settings.help: Teams file their own row for a map and you approve it before it counts. Useful on big events where you would otherwise be typing in results teams already sent you. Off by default.
